note: Priced lifestyle add-ons that approximate condo facilities for an HDB option, plus low-cost public alternatives. Prices are user-overridable inputs with a sourced default and an as_of date. Never assume an operator exists: operating.status says whether it was confirmed to be operating and priced in Singapore on as_of. Items with price null have no verified default: the user must supply monthly.
